acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Default router.toml; the prompt matches a risk rule; the chat model differs from the fuerte model.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Run the hook with that UserPromptSubmit input.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Exit 0, a systemMessage warning naming the fuerte model, additionalContext with tier and risk; the prompt is not blocked.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: cargo test -p router-core desktop_hook; cargo test -p router-cli --test hook_cli

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: router.toml with [desktop_hook] block_high_risk = true; same risky prompt and lower model.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: decision block with a reason naming the fuerte model and effort.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Risky prompt; the chat already uses the fuerte model; blocking on.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Context only: no warning and no block.
Context recommends economico from a fast rule; no systemMessage.
Context says no rule applied and names fallback_tier; no classifier call.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Invalid stdin, or an invalid router.toml.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: Exit 0, empty stdout, reason on stderr; the prompt passes.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: ROUDEX_ROUTER_INTERNAL is set (RouDex's own app-server turns).
A decision for (session_id, turn_id) is already stored.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Run the hook again for the same turn.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: One row for that turn, updated; prompt text is never stored.

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: hooks.json with unrelated hooks and the legacy route-prompt hook.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: One RouDex entry after both installs, legacy entry removed, unrelated hooks preserved; uninstall removes only RouDex entries.
A Codex Desktop card shows messages by tier, warnings, blocks and whether the hook is installed.
acceptance_scenarios.verification: cargo test -p router-core desktop_hook; ui/tests/chat-fixture.html in the browser

acceptance_scenarios.precondition: Hook installed and trusted in the user's Codex.
acceptance_scenarios.action: Send a risky prompt from Codex with a non-fuerte model.
acceptance_scenarios.observable_result: The warning appears in Codex and the decision shows in the RouDex Resumen.
